metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: This movie is a perfect blend of action, comedy, and heart, with a killer soundtrack, much like the fun, high-octane adventure they enjoyed in Thor: Ragnarok and Jumanji.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Visually stunning and incredibly fun, this animated film offers a unique and energetic superhero story with a great sense of humor, fitting their enjoyment of comedic action like Sonic the Hedgehog 3.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult classic that mixes martial arts, fantasy, and hilarious one-liners, offering the same kind of offbeat adventure and comedy they liked in The Nice Guys and Seven Psychopaths.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Pure, unadulterated joy and charm. This feel-good family film is incredibly uplifting and funny, providing a comforting and delightful watch.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever and hilarious rom-com with a sci-fi twist that keeps things fresh and entertaining. It offers a lighthearted escape with plenty of laughs, similar to the comedic elements in their watched fantasy/action films.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: If they enjoyed the humor and action of Thor: Ragnarok and The Nice Guys, they'll love Deadpool's R-rated comedy, meta-humor, and stylish action sequences.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A visually inventive and action-packed comedy with a fantastic soundtrack. It's a quirky and fun ride that appeals to those who enjoy stylized fantasy and comedy.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A timeless fairy tale adventure that's as funny as it is charming. Its blend of swashbuckling, romance, and witty dialogue makes it a perfect feel-good watch.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: A modern whodunit with a stellar cast and sharp humor. Given their interest in 'Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery' and 'The Nice Guys,' this is a must-watch for its clever mystery and comedic undertones.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: An energetic and hilarious animated adventure about a quirky family saving the world from a robot apocalypse. It's filled with humor and heart, reminiscent of their enjoyment of Jumanji and Sonic the Hedgehog 3.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful blend of animation and live-action that's a charming and funny fairy tale for adults. It captures a whimsical, lighthearted fantasy spirit.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious action-comedy with a fantastic performance from Melissa McCarthy. It delivers plenty of laughs and surprising action, fitting their enjoyment of comedic thrillers like Get Shorty.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming and romantic film with a touch of sci-fi. It's a feel-good story about life and love, offering a comforting and uplifting viewing experience.

metas.name: Kick-Ass
metas.description: A satirical and action-packed superhero film that doesn't take itself too seriously. It blends violent action with a dark sense of humor, appealing to their taste for fun, albeit more violent, action-comedies.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: Stylish, witty, and full of over-the-top action. This spy comedy offers a fun and exhilarating ride, similar to the blend of action and humor they liked in 'The Nice Guys' and 'Three Kings'.

metas.name: School of Rock
metas.description: A pure feel-good comedy with a fantastic soundtrack. Jack Black's energy is infectious, making for a thoroughly enjoyable and uplifting movie.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Homecoming
metas.description: This Marvel entry is known for its youthful energy, humor, and a focus on the fun aspects of being a superhero, fitting their enjoyment of 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A brilliant parody of sci-fi tropes that is also a genuinely fun adventure. It's smart, funny, and surprisingly heartfelt, aligning with their love for comedic fantasy and adventure.

metas.name: Groundhog Day
metas.description: A classic comedy with a thought-provoking premise. It's consistently funny and surprisingly optimistic, a perfect lighthearted watch.

metas.name: Romancing the Stone
metas.description: A classic action-adventure rom-com with plenty of charm and excitement. It's a fun treasure hunt with great chemistry, echoing the adventure of Jumanji.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: A hilarious and fast-paced animated comedy from Disney. Its witty dialogue and zany characters make it incredibly fun and rewatchable.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A post-apocalyptic comedy that is both thrilling and hilarious. Its unique take on survival and character dynamics offers a fun, action-packed experience.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: From Edgar Wright, this action-comedy is a masterclass in genre parody and clever writing. It's packed with laughs and surprisingly exciting action, fitting their enjoyment of 'The Nice Guys' and 'Seven Psychopaths'.

metas.name: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
metas.description: A pure, goofy delight. This time-traveling comedy is full of good vibes and memorable characters, a perfect choice for lighthearted fun.

metas.name: The LEGO Movie
metas.description: Surprisingly witty and visually innovative, this animated film is a laugh-out-loud adventure for all ages. It captures a sense of fun and creativity they might enjoy from 'Jumanji'.

metas.name: Silver Linings Playbook
metas.description: A feel-good romantic comedy-drama that is both funny and touching. It balances serious themes with hopeful moments and great performances.

metas.name: Midnight Run
metas.description: A buddy cop comedy that’s non-stop action and banter. The chemistry between the leads makes it a highly entertaining and fun watch, similar to 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Shrek
metas.description: A groundbreaking animated comedy that subverts fairy tale tropes with humor and heart. It's a fun and refreshing fantasy adventure.

metas.name: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
metas.description: A classic sports comedy that is consistently hilarious and features a memorable cast. It's pure, unadulterated fun.

metas.name: Napoleon Dynamite
metas.description: A quirky, deadpan comedy with a unique sense of humor. It's an endearing and undeniably funny film that offers a different kind of lighthearted enjoyment.

metas.name: Back to the Future
metas.description: A perfect blend of sci-fi, adventure, and comedy. It's an endlessly enjoyable and optimistic film that's a joy to watch.

metas.name: Ant-Man
metas.description: This Marvel film offers a more grounded and comedic take on the superhero genre, with clever heists and lighthearted banter, appealing to their love for fun action like 'Thor: Ragnarok'.

metas.name: Miss Congeniality
metas.description: A charming and funny romantic comedy with a great performance from Sandra Bullock. It's a lighthearted story with plenty of laughs and a feel-good resolution.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A fun and energetic musical comedy with a fantastic soundtrack and great ensemble cast. It's uplifting and entertaining, with plenty of comedic moments.

metas.name: The Hunt for Red October
metas.description: While a thriller, its focus on intelligence and a thrilling cat-and-mouse game at sea can be engaging and satisfying without being overly stressful. It's a well-crafted adventure with a satisfying conclusion.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: A vibrant and glamorous romantic comedy with a lot of heart and humor. It's a delightful escape into a world of wealth and romance.

metas.name: The Muppet Movie
metas.description: A classic, joyful, and musical road trip adventure. It's pure, unadulterated fun with iconic characters and songs, perfect for a lighthearted mood.

metas.name: The Other Guys
metas.description: A hilarious buddy cop action-comedy that perfectly captures the spirit of fun and absurdity. It's packed with laughs and great comedic performances, similar to 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: The Death of Stalin
metas.description: A darkly comedic satire that is surprisingly hilarious despite its subject matter. It’s sharp, witty, and offers a unique brand of humor they might appreciate from 'Seven Psychopaths' and 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Singin' in the Rain
metas.description: An absolute classic of musical cinema, overflowing with joy, spectacular dance numbers, and infectious humor. It's a pure feel-good movie that's incredibly light and fun.
